Our analysis includes whole-genome sequencing data from fibroblasts, iPSCs, and DANPCs and the development of NeuriTest, an RNAseq-based bioinformatic analysis of DANPCs designed to predict cell quality based on empirical animal data. Autologous cell therapies are immune matched to the patient, potentially augmenting durability of benefit compared to allogeneic cells while negating the need for immunosuppression and accompanying side effects. Patient-specific iPSCs are an autologous cell source that can be differentiated to dopaminergic neurons, the cell type lost in PD. We report here our preclinical manufacturing strategy and results demonstrating efficacy in a PD rodent model and safety in a 9-month GLP toxicology study.
papers.whyCare: Genomic and transcriptomic QC for a cell therapy may provide practical assays or quality benchmarks relevant to engineered cells.
papers.skepticism: Potentially useful for designing genome-integrity and expression readouts after editing or cell engineering.

lensReasons.main: 환자 유래 도파민 전구세포의 유전체·전사체 품질평가를 여러 공여자에서 재현하고, 파킨슨병 설치류 효능과 9개월 GLP 독성 자료까지 제시한 임상 번역 연구다.
lensReasons.computational: RNA-seq 기반 품질 예측 도구가 포함되지만, 핵심은 세포치료 제조·전임상 검증이다.

papers.title: MIMOSA: Guiding De Novo Antibody Design with Natural Interaction Fingerprints
papers.abstract: De novo antibody design promises to transform therapeutic antibody and nanobody discovery. Yet, success remains inconsistent across targets, with generative models often yielding no experimentally validated binders. Here we introduce MIMOSA (MIMic-Oriented Structural Antibody generation), a model-agnostic, inference-time framework that constrains diffusion-based antibody design pipelines to reproduce the interaction geometry and chemistry of a target's known cognate binder interface. Rather than searching for a productive interface from scratch, MIMOSA constrains generation around residue identities and geometries already known to support binding, while allowing the generative model to complete the surrounding antibody interface. We test MIMOSA on different interface topologies: contiguous motifs that fit within a single CDR loop and spatially dispersed hotspots distributed across the paratope. Applied without retraining to two architecturally distinct generators (RFAntibody and BoltzGen), this framework delivers experimentally validated binders-achieving sub-micromolar to single-digit nanomolar affinities-at 20-26% hit rates on three targets on which unconstrained methods produce zero or near-zero binders: KEAP1, uPA, and IL-8. By turning any target with a structurally characterised cognate binder into an accessible de novo design problem, this framework broadens the practical reach of generative antibody design to targets where unconstrained approaches currently fail.
papers.shortSummary: 알려진 cognate binder의 결합면 잔기와 기하를 생성 과정에 제약으로 넣으면, 재학습 없이 기존 생성 모델이 실패하거나 거의 실패하는 일부 표적에서 실험적으로 결합하는 de novo 항체를 얻을 수 있다는 주장이다.
papers.whyCare: 워크플로를 ‘표적에 맞는 결합면을 처음부터 탐색’하는 방식에서 ‘검증된 cognate binder의 상호작용 지문을 보존하며 주변 항체 구조를 생성’하는 방식으로 바꾼다. 특히 기존 생성기가 잘 맞지 않는 표적에 적용할 수 있는 실용적 제약 전략이다.
papers.skepticism: 초록은 3개 표적과 20–26% 적중률을 보고하지만 후보 수, 적중 정의, 대조군의 실험 규모 및 친화도 분포는 제시하지 않는다. 이미 알려진 cognate binder의 표적별 구조 정보가 방법의 핵심 입력이므로, 이는 일반화된 de novo 능력의 증명이라기보다 정보가 풍부한 표적에서의 조건부 설계다. 표적 선택의 대표성, 정보 누출과 구별되는 평가 설계, 실험 반복성·재현성, 코드 및 모델 접근성은 초록만으로 확인할 수 없다. 실험 검증 주장은 있으나 그 강도와 범위는 본문 확인이 필요하다.

lensReasons.main: 자연 결합체의 상호작용 형상을 설계에 반영해, 기존 비제약 설계가 실패한 세 표적에서 결합체를 얻었다. 실험 결합 친화도는 sub-micromolar에서 한 자릿수 nM까지 보고됐다.
lensReasons.computational: 두 생성 설계기에 적용 가능한 추론 시점 제약법을 제시하고, 세 표적에서 실험적으로 결합체를 확인했다.

papers.title: Design and Evolution of an Orthogonal HaloTag for Multiplexed Labeling in Cells
papers.abstract: The self-labeling protein HaloTag is used to install a wide variety of functional small molecules in cells and living organisms with exquisite specificity with respect to cell type and subcellular localization. HaloTag is a core part of many biotechnology-based tools for sensing, tracking, and manipulating biological systems with a high degree of spatial and temporal control. Due to the limitations of fluorescent proteins and other self-labeling proteins, most of these tools have historically been restricted to a single channel. In this work, we used structure-guided rational design and directed evolution to produce an orthogonal HaloTag protein called OrthoTag which reacts selectively with a modified chloroalkane substrate. OrthoTag retains many of HaloTag's superior properties, and reaction rate measurements with purified proteins show OrthoTag and its substrate have 109-fold mutual orthogonality to HaloTag with respect to substrate concentration. We demonstrate the application of OrthoTag for multiplexed labeling experiments in mammalian cells with minimal optimization. Going forward, OrthoTag should be straightforward to incorporate into HaloTag-based systems to allow simultaneous measurement or manipulation of two biological targets or processes. The availability of multiple high-performance self-labeling proteins will enable the continued development of new multiplexed biotechnology methods.
papers.shortSummary: 변형 chloroalkane 기질에 선택적으로 반응하는 OrthoTag를 만들어 HaloTag와 함께 세포 내 다중 표지에 사용할 수 있다고 주장한다.
papers.whyCare: 유전체 편집에서 Cas9과 DNA 복구 인자처럼 두 표적의 시간·공간적 변화를 동시에 추적할 수 있다. AI-biology에서도 세포 상태나 편집 반응에 대한 다중 채널 데이터를 만들 잠재력이 있지만, 이 초록은 해당 응용의 성능을 직접 입증하지는 않는다.
papers.skepticism: 세포에서 직교성이 얼마나 유지되는지와 표지 효율·배경·기능 교란 정도를 판단할 정량 데이터가 초록에 없다. 다양한 세포 유형이나 내인성 발현 조건에서의 재현성도 확인되지 않는다.

lensReasons.main: 구조 기반 설계와 유도진화로 기존 HaloTag 기질과 상호 직교하는 태그를 만들고 포유류 세포에서 다중 표지 적용성을 보인 유용한 단백질공학 도구다.
lensReasons.computational: 구조 기반 설계가 포함되지만 핵심은 실험적 단백질 진화와 세포 적용이다.

papers.title: Mitotic single-stranded DNA suppression by DDIAS
papers.abstract: Cells undergoing division mount a unique response to DNA damage that ensures accurate chromosome segregation. The CIP2A-TOPBP1 complex has emerged as an important mitotic genome maintenance factor, but its function remains unclear. Here, we report that DDIAS is a DNA-binding effector of the CIP2A pathway in human cells. DDIAS physically interacts with TOPBP1, and its inactivation causes synthetic lethality with BRCA1 and BRCA2 deficiency. Homologous recombination (HR)-deficient tumors upregulate DDIAS to enable HR-deficient cells to tolerate their genomic instability. Mechanistically, DDIAS is a single-stranded DNA (ssDNA)-binding protein that promotes the repair of ssDNA carried from interphase into mitosis. Mitotic ssDNA in HR-deficient cells is exacerbated by poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) inhibition, and DDIAS-dependent suppression of these lesions involves mitotic DNA synthesis, which promotes accurate chromosome segregation and survival. We propose that DDIAS defines a mitotic DNA repair system downstream of CIP2A that mitigates the threat of mitotic ssDNA for genome integrity.
papers.whyCare: A mechanism controlling ssDNA availability could inform how DNA substrates are protected or exposed, although the title concerns mitosis rather than editing.
papers.skepticism: Could suggest hypotheses about ssDNA accessibility, protection, or cellular responses relevant to editor activity and DNA damage.

lensReasons.main: DDIAS가 CIP2A-TOPBP1 경로의 ssDNA 결합 효과기로 유사분열 DNA 합성과 염색체 분리를 돕고, BRCA1/2 결핍 및 PARP 억제에 대한 취약성을 제시한다.
lensReasons.computational: 세포 기반 기능·기전 분석이 핵심이며 계산 방법론이 주기여는 아니다.

papers.title: Probing the sequence variability tolerance in a de novo α-helical barrel biocatalyst
papers.abstract: De novo-designed enzymes have recently achieved high catalytic activity and stereoselectivity while demonstrating exceptional thermostability in entirely novel protein scaffolds. Among these, -helical barrel protein scaffolds are attractive structures for biocatalysis due to their structural simplicity, high thermostability, and rationalizable sequence patterning. However, enabling major structural reengineering of these scaffolds while maintaining the structure, stability and catalytic activity while also improving soluble protein production remain major challenges and pose the fundamental question how engineerable a de novo backbone-sequence pair is. Here, we combine deep learning based and classic computational protein design to modify and optimize de novo -helical barrel biocatalysts. Using the previously reported six-helical barrel 6H5L as a model scaffold, AlphaFold2-guided RosettaRemodel enabled the design of a truncated variant, whose crystal structure closely matches the design model. Additional sequence-redesign using ProteinMPNN generated a variant with a tenfold increase of soluble protein yield in Escherichia coli. Biochemical, biophysical, and structural analyses showed that both variants retained the overall barrel architecture, high thermal stability, and catalytic activity for both purified protein and whole-cell systems. Detailed kinetic analysis on the variants showed both variation in kcat and Km, reflecting changes in catalytic turnover and substrate binding. Together, these approaches provide new insights and possibilities for the further engineering of functional de novo -helical barrels, their ability to withstand dramatically large sequence changes and their broader application in biocatalysis and biotechnology.
papers.shortSummary: AlphaFold2-guided RosettaRemodel과 ProteinMPNN을 이용하면 de novo α-helical barrel 6H5L의 구조 또는 서열을 크게 바꾸면서도 구조적 안정성과 촉매 활성을 유지하고 가용성 발현을 개선할 수 있다고 주장한다.
papers.whyCare: Genome editing을 직접 다루지는 않지만, AI 기반 단백질 설계가 구조 변경과 발현성 개선을 함께 달성할 수 있는지 보여주는 사례다. 효소 설계·발현 실험을 하는 AI-biology 팀에 설계-구조-기능 검증의 비교 기준을 제공한다.
papers.skepticism: 10배 수율 증가의 비교 기준과 실험 조건, kcat·Km의 실제 값 및 촉매 효율 변화, 반복 수가 초록에 없어 개선의 실질적 크기와 재현성을 평가할 수 없다. 또한 한 scaffold 사례라 일반화 근거가 제한적이다.

lensReasons.main: 새로운 α-나선 배럴 효소의 큰 서열·구조 변경에도 촉매 기능과 안정성이 유지됨을 구조·생화학 분석으로 보였다. 설계 단백질의 발현량도 10배 높였다.
lensReasons.computational: 구조 예측 기반 리모델링과 ProteinMPNN 설계를 결정구조 및 촉매·생물리 분석으로 시험했다.

papers.title: Convergent evolution of metabolic regulation governs redox adaptation in Toxoplasma
papers.abstract: Diverse organisms adjust metabolic gene expression during crowding as they encounter nutrient scarcity, oxidative stress, and waste accumulation. Apicomplexan parasites experience these stresses during intracellular growth within host cells yet lack known regulators of metabolic adaptation. We screened the apicomplexan parasite Toxoplasma gondii to identify genes that support parasite fitness during crowding. Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD)(P) + biosynthesis was required at high parasite density, along with several parasite-specific factors, including an RNA-binding protein we named "T. gondii parasite response to oxidation" (TgPRO). TgPRO loss elevated reactive oxygen species under ambient conditions, which was rescued by growth at low oxygen levels. TgPRO regulates the expression of transcripts involved in carbon metabolism and iron-sulfur cluster assembly. Regulation of the iron-sulfur cluster assembly protein ISCU relies on TgPRO binding to the transcript's 3' UTR. Through convergent evolution, TgPRO performs a role analogous to that of known metabolic regulators from other species, representing the first dedicated regulator of metabolic gene expression in apicomplexans.
papers.whyCare: A potentially instructive mechanism for metabolic and redox adaptation, though it is in a parasite and has no explicit editor connection.
papers.skepticism: May offer ideas about mitochondrial metabolism, redox stress, or evolutionary routes to cellular adaptation.

lensReasons.main: 기생충 적합도 스크린으로 TgPRO를 찾고, 3′ UTR 결합을 통한 ISCU 및 대사 전사체 조절이 산화 스트레스 적응에 기여함을 보인다. 대사 조절 기전은 흥미롭지만 연구 초점은 기생충에 있다.
lensReasons.computational: 스크린과 RNA 결합·기능 검증이 핵심이며 계산 방법론은 주기여가 아니다.

papers.title: Spatiotemporal clonal architecture of the newborn mouse forebrain
papers.abstract: How hundreds of cell types of the mammalian forebrain emerge from a limited set of progenitor cells during development remains largely unknown 1-3 , and studies so far have overwhelmingly focused on the cerebral cortex. Here, to fill this gap, we applied lentiviral barcoding across the major subdivisions of the mouse forebrain: cortex, hippocampus, striatum, thalamus and olfactory bulb. We registered cellular profiles to their anatomical distribution using spatial transcriptomics, creating an atlas of clonal cell lineage relationships across a newborn mouse forebrain. We uncover previously unrecognized differences in generation of ventral and dorsal medium spiny neurons, as well as unexplored lineage relationships between late-born medium spiny neurons, striatal astrocytes and distinct subpopulations of the olfactory bulb neurons. We show that clones of GABAergic (γ-aminobutyric acid-producing) neurons with broad regional dispersion are enriched for genes implicated in neurodevelopmental disorders. Our results highlight a developmental principle whereby glutamatergic neurons and astrocytes are clonally related and retained within their region of origin, whereas GABAergic neurons are clonally related to oligodendrocyte precursor cells but disperse extensively across brain regions. Together, our findings will serve as a foundational reference for studies of mammalian forebrain development and its disorders.
papers.whyCare: A clonal-architecture study may offer useful lineage-tracing or spatial analysis approaches, though the title gives no direct editor or organelle connection.
papers.skepticism: Potentially reusable lineage-mapping assays or analysis strategies for cell-engineering and screening studies.

lensReasons.main: 렌티바이러스 바코딩과 공간 전사체를 결합해 신생 생쥐 전뇌의 계통 관계와 세포 분산을 보여주며, 뉴런·성상교세포·희소돌기아교 전구세포의 발생 관계에 관한 구체적 관찰을 제공한다. 계통 추적과 발달 생물학에는 참고할 만하지만, 주로 뇌 발달 atlas여서 제시된 연구 방향들과의 직접적 접점은 제한적이다.
lensReasons.computational: 공간 전사체와 바코드 기반 계통 정보를 통합해 세포의 해부학적 분포를 정리하지만, 계산 방법 자체가 주된 혁신으로 제시되지는 않는다. 핵심 기여는 전뇌 발생 계통에 관한 자료와 생물학적 관찰이다.

papers.title: PRIME: A modular plasmid-based platform for continuous in vivo evolution across bacteria
papers.abstract: Directed evolution enables the engineering of proteins with novel or improved functions, yet existing approaches often require extensive manual intervention and are difficult to sustain over long evolutionary trajectories. Here we introduce PRIME (Protein-primed Replication for In vivo Mutagenesis and Evolution), a plasmid-based orthogonal DNA replication system for continuous directed evolution in Escherichia coli. PRIME harnesses protein-primed DNA replication to establish an autonomous replicon that operates independently of the host genome. Coupling this system to an error-prone DNA polymerase enables targeted diversification of constructs encoded on the orthogonal plasmid while preserving genomic integrity. Using only standard laboratory equipment, we demonstrate the evolution of a construct expressing msfGFP with an 11.8-fold increase in fluorescence. The platform is fully compatible with standard molecular biology workflows and requires no specialised instrumentation. We further demonstrate its portability across bacterial hosts by establishing PRIME in Pseudomonas putida. PRIME thus provides a broadly accessible framework for continuous in vivo evolution, with wide-ranging applications in protein engineering and synthetic biology.
papers.shortSummary: PRIME은 protein-primed orthogonal plasmid 복제와 error-prone polymerase를 결합해 세균에서 표적 construct를 지속적으로 변이·진화시킬 수 있다는 것이 핵심 주장이다.
papers.whyCare: 실험실에서 설계한 변이체를 반복 제작하는 부담을 낮춰, AI가 제안한 단백질 후보를 실험적으로 탐색하는 루프에 연결할 잠재력이 있다. Cas 단백질의 PAM 인식 등 genome-editing 관련 성능 진화에도 응용 가능하지만, 초록은 편집 효소 진화를 보여주지 않는다.
papers.skepticism: 초록만으로는 결과의 재현성이나 변이의 plasmid 내 제한을 판단하기 어렵다. 반복 수·대조군·변이율 및 스펙트럼·숙주 염색체 분석이 보고되지 않았으며, P. putida에서 진화가 작동하는지도 불분명하다.

lensReasons.main: 세균에서 유전체를 보존하면서 플라스미드 표적을 지속 진화시키는 플랫폼이다. GFP 형광 개선과 Pseudomonas 적용을 보여 단백질공학·합성생물학에 직접 유용하다.
lensReasons.computational: 계산 모델보다 직교 복제계와 오류유발 중합효소를 이용한 실험 플랫폼이 핵심이다.

papers.title: SRSF1 modulates the dark nucleolar cap pH to restore nucleolar integrity and function
papers.abstract: The nucleolus is a multiphase condensate with three subcompartments organized by an internal pH gradient. Although pH regulates condensate dynamics and function, how it is controlled under various physiological and pathological conditions remains poorly understood. Here we show that splicing factor SRSF1 is shuttled from nuclear speckles to the dark nucleolar caps (DNCs) under stress that often interrogates nucleolar rRNA synthesis. SRSF1 DNC localization is partially reliant on a molecular interaction with DDX18. Loss of SRSF1 impedes the pH homeostasis of the DNCs and subsequently obstructs the restoration of the nucleolar multiphase and functional recovery from stress. The arginine/serine-rich (RS) domain of SRSF1, due to its high positive charge, is accountable for alkalizing the DNC microenvironment. Interestingly, synthetic arginine-rich dipeptide derivatives of the SRSF1 RS domain safeguard the nucleolus from pH and functional disturbance. Our findings uncover unprecedented mechanistic insights into pH regulation of the nucleolar caps.
papers.whyCare: A mechanistic finding about pH control and organelle integrity, but the nucleolus is not a direct lab focus.
papers.skepticism: Could prompt discussion of how local pH regulates organelle-like compartments and cellular function.

lensReasons.main: SRSF1의 RS 도메인이 핵소체 암부 캡의 pH 항상성을 유지해 스트레스 후 기능 회복을 돕는다는 응축체 기전을 제시하고, 합성 펩타이드 유도체의 보호 효과도 보인다.
lensReasons.computational: 핵심은 세포 내 pH 조절과 펩타이드 기능 실험이며 계산·AI가 주기여는 아니다.

papers.title: Written in development and lost in ageing: the grammar of cellular identity
papers.abstract: Ageing has been described through many theoretical frameworks, yet its mechanistic basis remains unresolved. Here we propose that ageing reflects progressive decanalization of mammalian cell identity, driven by erosion of a regulatory grammar written during development. Extending Waddington's epigenetic landscape, development canalizes cell fates through globally coordinated chromatin programs that establish identity constraints across multiple timescales. Subsequently, these constraints can only be maintained through local mechanisms with limited fidelity. The asymmetry between high-fidelity writing and imperfect maintenance generates predictable drift that accumulates with biological time. Antagonistic chromatin pathways, particularly polycomb repressive complex 2 (PRC2)-mediated repression opposed by H3K4/36 methylation and RNA polymerase II binding, enforce identity boundaries through mutual constraint. With age, this balance erodes. Consistent with this framework, the vast majority of age-associated DNA methylation gain in somatic mitotic tissues occurs at PRC2-bound low-methylated regions, indicating that these domains function as conserved coordinates of slow-layer drift. This model explains cross-tissue ageing signatures, developmental timing-to-lifespan correlations and robustness of pan-mammalian epigenetic ageing clocks. It provides testable predictions for interventions that stabilize architecture to preserve cellular identity and function.
papers.whyCare: A potentially broad account of how cellular identity is established and changes with age could inform cell-state interpretation.
papers.skepticism: May offer concepts or measurements useful for interpreting cell states in perturbation or engineering experiments.

lensReasons.main: 발달 과정에서 확립된 염색질 정체성의 유지 실패가 노화에 따른 세포 정체성 표류로 이어진다는 개념적 틀을 제안하고, PRC2 결합 영역의 메틸화 변화와 연결한다. 노화와 후성유전학의 관계를 생각하는 데 흥미롭지만, 초록상 기전적 검증보다는 모델과 기존 관찰의 통합에 가깝다.
lensReasons.computational: 계산 방법론을 제시하는 연구는 아니며, 노화 관련 DNA 메틸화 패턴을 개념적 틀의 근거로 사용한다. 초록에서 새로운 계산 분석의 중심적 역할은 드러나지 않는다.

papers.title: RNASeek: A Cross-Phyla Generative Foundation Model for Multipurpose RNA Modeling and Reinforcement Learning-Based Design
papers.abstract: RNA plays central roles in regulating information flow and provides a versatile substrate for engineering biological functions. While large language models (LLMs) have transformed natural language processing and protein design, a general framework connecting RNA foundation models to functional sequence design remains limited. Here, we present RNASeek, a 1.6-billion-parameter generative foundation model built on a DeepSeek architecture and trained on a cross-phyla transcriptomic corpus for RNA sequence representation and generation. Natural-language tokens enable flexible conditional prediction and sequence design using a unified backbone. RNASeek captures species-specific transcript features and intron-exon boundaries in a zero-shot setting. We then fine-tune RNASeek to predict ribozyme self-cleavage activity and viral mRNA stability, revealing interpretable sequence features associated with function, including ribozyme loop flexibility and stem stability, as well as AU-rich motifs associated with mRNA stability. We use these functional predictors as reward models and apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to update the generation policy of RNASeek toward sequences with desired properties. GRPO-guided generation produces faster-cleaving ribozymes and stability-enhancing 3' UTRs while satisfying user-specified IUPAC constraints. Experimentally validated RNASeek-generated ribozymes achieve wild-type levels of activity, while RNASeek-generated 3' UTR sequences exceed the performance of the training data and benchmarked AI-generated 3' UTRs. Together, RNASeek establishes a unified pretrain-predict-optimize framework that connects learned RNA function to controllable de novo sequence design and provides a general strategy for engineering regulatory RNAs with desired properties.
papers.shortSummary: RNASeek은 교차계통 RNA 사전학습, 기능 예측, GRPO 최적화를 결합해 목표 기능을 가진 RNA 서열을 생성할 수 있다고 주장합니다.
papers.whyCare: 유전자 편집·AI biology 연구에서 RNA 조절 요소는 발현량, 안정성, 전달체 성능에 직접 영향을 줍니다. 사전학습 모델의 기능 예측을 보상 기반 생성과 연결한 방식은 편집 도구의 발현 카세트나 RNA 조절 서열을 목적 지향적으로 설계하는 데 응용될 수 있습니다.
papers.skepticism: 초록에는 정량 성능, 실험 표본 수와 반복, 비교군의 세부 조건, 독립 데이터 검증 및 보상 모델의 과최적화 여부가 없어 재현성과 일반화 범위를 평가하기 어렵습니다.

lensReasons.main: RNA 생성 모델을 리보자임과 3′ UTR 설계에 적용하고 생성 서열의 기능을 실험 검증해, 조절 RNA 공학에 직접 연결되는 도구를 제시한다.
lensReasons.computational: 주된 접근은 대규모 생성 모델과 강화학습이지만, 설계 RNA의 활성을 실험으로 검증해 합성생물학과 교차한다.

papers.title: OpenEvo: An Open-Source Platform for Automated Evolution and Analysis
papers.abstract: Here we introduce OpenEvo, a fully open-source, low-cost turbidostat platform for automated continuous culture and directed evolution experiments. Existing tools are expensive, complex, or lack open-source hardware; OpenEvo fills this gap with a complete, fully automated evolution platform, detailed illustrated construction instructions for beginners, open-source software and firmware, and a price point around $300. An optional PC-based interface offers enhanced functionality, including remote access, programmable evolution cycles, programmable LED stimulation, and a data visualization tool. OpenEvo can cycle through three types of media for positive, negative, and neutral selection conditions, supporting a wide range of experimental designs. We validate the use of OpenEvo by evolving Haloferax volcanii to grow from 15% to 12% salt over ~150 cycles, ~1,000 hours. Evolved cells grew 55% faster than wild-type at 12% salt. Whole-genome sequencing of adapted cells found SNPs and large deletions. We also demonstrate positive and negative selection using the OpenEvo LEDs to drive optogenetics via a Phytochrome B-based optogenetic tool, with light as the selection stimulus during over 4000 hours of growth. OpenEvo lowers the technical and cost barriers for continuous evolution experiments, serves as a teaching tool, and is designed to grow an open community of users who share modifications.
papers.shortSummary: OpenEvo는 저비용 오픈소스 하드웨어와 소프트웨어로 자동 연속배양 및 directed evolution 실험의 접근성을 높일 수 있다는 것이 핵심 주장이다.
papers.whyCare: 유전체 편집·AI biology 연구에서 변이체를 선택압 아래 장기간 배양하는 실험의 장비 장벽을 낮출 수 있다. 특히 편집 라이브러리의 표현형 선택을 연속배양과 연결하는 기반이 될 수 있지만, 라이브러리 추적이나 AI 기반 실험 제어가 입증된 것은 아니다.
papers.skepticism: 초록에는 반복 수와 장치 간 재현성, 종·배지별 운전 범위, 센서·제어 성능의 정량 비교가 없다. 따라서 한 균주에서의 성공을 다른 연구 균주나 편집 라이브러리로 일반화하기 어렵다.

lensReasons.main: 저비용 자동 연속배양 장치로 염도 적응 진화와 광유전학 기반 선택을 장기간 시연했다. 합성생물학 교육·실험에는 유용하지만, 제시된 생물학적 발견은 제한적이다.
lensReasons.computational: 주된 기여는 오픈소스 장치와 자동화 소프트웨어이며, 계산 모델링은 핵심이 아니다.

papers.title: Deep learning perturbation models can outperform baselines on calibrated metrics
papers.abstract: Abstract Recent benchmarks report that deep-learning-based genetic perturbation models fail to outperform uninformative baselines. Here we introduce a positive control baseline and metric calibration framework, showing—across 14 datasets and 18 metrics—that common benchmarking metrics (for example, mean squared error and Pearson Δ ) are frequently miscalibrated, with reduced sensitivity to measure positive model performance. Under well-calibrated metrics, we find that deep-learning-based genetic perturbation models can outperform uninformative baselines.
papers.shortSummary: 핵심 주장: perturbation 모델이 기준선보다 못하다는 기존 결론의 일부는 성능 지표의 보정 문제에서 비롯될 수 있다. 접근: positive-control baseline과 metric calibration framework를 제안하고 14개 데이터셋, 18개 지표에서 평가했다. 근거: MSE와 Pearson Δ 등 흔한 지표가 자주 miscalibrated되어 양의 모델 성능을 감지하는 민감도가 낮았다고 보고한다.
papers.whyCare: 편집기·세포 perturbation 효과 예측이나 computational directed evolution 모델의 벤치마크에도 지표 민감도와 기준선 선택이 중요하다. 다만 이 연구가 해당 과제들에서의 전이 가능성이나 편집기 성능 향상을 직접 보여주는 것은 아니다.
papers.takeaway: perturbation 예측 성능을 해석할 때 모델만 비교하지 말고, 지표가 positive control을 감지하는지와 baseline이 정보성 있는지부터 확인해야 한다.
papers.skepticism: 초록에는 metric calibration의 세부 정의, positive control의 구성, 데이터셋별 결과 크기와 분산이 없다. 보정된 지표에서 일부 deep-learning 모델이 uninformative baseline을 능가했다는 결과를 모든 과제의 우월성이나 생물학적 유용성으로 일반화해서는 안 된다.
papers.blurb: perturbation 모델 비교 전 지표부터 검증하라는 실용적 벤치마킹 논문—우리 perturb-seq 평가에 한 번 적용해 볼 가치가 있다.

lensReasons.main: 유전자 교란 예측 모델의 비교 지표를 14개 데이터셋에서 재평가한 방법론 연구로, Perturb-seq 해석에는 유용하지만 생물학적 기전 검증은 제시하지 않는다.
lensReasons.computational: 계산 모델 벤치마크와 지표 보정이 주기여이며 실험적 생물학 검증은 없다.

papers.title: GenAI-Net: A generative AI framework for automated biomolecular network design
papers.abstract: Biomolecular networks underlie both natural biological processes and engineered cellular technologies, from intracellular regulation and ecological dynamics to biomanufacturing, smart therapeutics, and cell-based diagnostics. However, designing chemical reaction networks (CRNs) that implement a desired dynamical function remains a challenging task. Although candidate networks can be evaluated by simulation, the inverse problem of discovering networks from behavioral specifications remains difficult. It requires navigating vast spaces of topologies and kinetic parameters governed by nonlinear and potentially stochastic dynamics. Here, we introduce GenAI-Net, a generative artificial intelligence framework that automates CRN design by coupling reaction proposal to simulation-based evaluation defined by a user-specified objective. GenAI-Net efficiently produces topologically diverse solutions across design tasks, including dose-response shaping, complex logic gates, classifiers, oscillators, habituation, robust perfect adaptation, and noise reduction in stochastic settings. By turning specifications into families of circuit candidates, GenAI-Net provides a route to programmable biomolecular circuit design and accelerates translation from desired function to implementable mechanisms.
papers.shortSummary: GenAI-Net은 사용자 지정 동역학 목표에 맞는 CRN 후보를 생성하고 시뮬레이션으로 평가해, 복수의 네트워크 설계 과제를 자동화할 수 있다는 주장이다.
papers.whyCare: 분자 네트워크 설계에서 기능 사양을 후보 생성과 시뮬레이션 평가로 연결하는 자동화 패턴을 제시한다. 다만 단백질·항체 설계나 구조예측의 워크플로를 직접 바꾸는 근거는 초록에 없다.
papers.skepticism: 초록에는 성공률, 탐색 비용, 기준 방법 대비 성능이 없다. 과제 선택이나 비교가 유리하게 설정됐는지, 코드·모델이 공개되어 재현 가능한지 확인이 필요하다. 초록에는 wet-lab 검증이나 prospective validation이 보고되지 않는다. 이는 부재를 단정하기보다 초록에서 확인되지 않는다는 뜻이다.

lensReasons.main: 회로 동역학 목표에서 다양한 반응 네트워크를 생성하는 합성생물학 도구지만, 제시된 평가는 시뮬레이션 중심이다.
lensReasons.computational: 생성 AI와 시뮬레이션이 주 기여이며, 설계 회로의 실험 구현·검증은 초록에 보고되지 않았다.

papers.title: SHERLOCK: Structured representation learning and causal inference of downstream perturbation effects
papers.abstract: Understanding the effects of genetic, molecular, and experimental perturbations is essential for decoding cellular mechanisms and guiding biomedical interventions. Existing computational approaches are typically designed for individual tasks, such as predicting perturbation responses, characterizing downstream transcriptional effects, or modeling perturbation combinations, and therefore do not provide a unified framework for learning interpretable perturbation representations while enabling causal analysis of downstream effects and characterization of condition-dependent responses. We present SHERLOCK, an interpretable deep generative framework for single-cell perturbation analysis that represents perturbation effects as structured interventions on a latent baseline cellular state. SHERLOCK learns correlated and sparse perturbation representations that organize genetic and pharmacological perturbations according to shared transcriptional responses. % By formulating perturbations as interventions within a structural causal model, it enables counterfactual estimation of their downstream transcriptional effects under explicit identifiability assumptions. The same framework quantifies how perturbation responses vary across conditions and compositionally models combinatorial perturbations, enabling prediction of held-out combinations and classification of genetic interactions. Across genome-scale CRISPR, chemical, and spatial perturbation datasets, SHERLOCK recovers perturbation relationships concordant with known biological pathways and pharmacological properties, identifies condition-dependent responses, and predicts combinatorial perturbation effects. Together, SHERLOCK provides a unified framework for interpretable and causal analysis of perturbation effects across diverse single-cell perturbation experiments.
papers.shortSummary: SHERLOCK은 perturbation을 latent baseline 세포 상태에 대한 구조화된 개입으로 모델링해 해석 가능한 표현학습, downstream 효과의 인과 추정, 조건 의존성 및 조합 효과 분석을 통합한다고 주장한다.
papers.whyCare: CRISPR 단일세포 perturbation 데이터에서 유전자 효과를 해석하고, 조건별 반응이나 조합 효과를 추정하는 통합 분석법이 될 가능성이 있다. 유전자 편집 실험의 후속 조합 후보를 좁히는 데 유용할 수 있지만, 현재는 검증된 실험 설계 도구라기보다 후보 생성·가설화 도구로 보는 편이 타당하다.
papers.skepticism: 초록에는 정량 결과와 기준 모델 비교, 데이터 규모, 외부 검증, 식별가능성 가정의 구체성이 없다. 따라서 'causal' 추정이 어떤 관측·설계 조건에서 신뢰 가능한지와 조합 예측의 실제 이득이 불분명하다.

lensReasons.main: 단일세포 CRISPR·약물·공간 섭동 자료의 효과와 조합 반응을 통합 분석하는 방법이다. Perturb-seq 연구에는 관련되지만, 초록의 기여는 분석 프레임워크에 집중된다.
lensReasons.computational: 인과 가정에 기반한 잠재표현·반사실 추정과 조합 섭동 예측이 핵심이며, 기존 데이터셋에서 알려진 경로와의 일치성을 평가했다.

papers.title: Immunoids: Building immunocompetent organoids from human pluripotent stem cells
papers.abstract: Pluripotent stem cell-derived immunocompetent organoids and assembloids, termed here "immunoids," are becoming important human models for studying immune-tissue interactions. Advances across organ systems now include incorporation of mature and immature immune populations into multiple organoid types, multilineage differentiation, and endogenous immune co-development. Defining standards for immunoid fabrication will be essential for improving physiological modeling and clinical translation. In the coming years, as these platforms mature, immunoids are poised to transform research by advancing our understanding of human development, disease mechanisms, and therapeutic responses, becoming a cornerstone of precision medicine.
papers.whyCare: A platform for building immunocompetent organoids may provide a reusable model for perturbation or functional screening.
papers.skepticism: Could offer organoid engineering or assay-design ideas relevant to testing cell perturbations and biological responses.

lensReasons.main: 면역세포를 포함한 인간 PSC 유래 오가노이드·어셈블로이드의 제작 현황과 표준화 필요성을 정리한 분야 리뷰로, 면역-조직 모델 연구에 참고가 된다.
lensReasons.computational: 방법론 논의와 전망을 다룬 리뷰이며 계산 연구가 핵심은 아니다.

papers.title: A geothermal amoeba sets a new upper temperature limit for eukaryotes
papers.abstract: The study of temperature limits has transformed our understanding of life's boundaries but has focused on bacteria and archaea. For decades after their discovery, no eukaryote was shown to replicate above 60°C. We isolated a geothermal amoeba, Incendiamoeba cascadensis, that divides at 63°C and is motile up to 64°C. We identified an enrichment of genes related to proteostasis and environmental sensing relative to mesophilic amoebae. Comparative RNA sequencing of I. cascadensis revealed upregulation of pathways related to proteostasis, DNA repair, and membrane trafficking at high temperatures. Predicted proteins of I. cascadensis have distinct biophysical properties, including enrichment of positively charged surface residues similar to bacterial and archaeal hyperthermophiles, which suggests a convergent mechanism for protein stability under temperature stress. Together, our findings expand our understanding of where and how life can persist.
papers.whyCare: Flagship curiosity item about an unusual eukaryotic extreme; no clear direct lab application from the title.
papers.skepticism: May prompt broader thinking about eukaryotic limits and cellular adaptation.

lensReasons.main: 진핵생물이 63°C에서 분열하는 사례는 생명 한계에 관한 이례적 발견이며 단백질 안정성·proteostasis의 후보 특성을 제시한다. 다만 해당 실험실의 주요 연구 방향과의 직접성은 낮다.
lensReasons.computational: 비교 전사체와 단백질 특성 예측은 해석을 보조하며, 계산 방법론 자체가 주기여는 아니다.

papers.title: CytoVI: deep generative modeling of antibody-based single cell data
papers.abstract: Antibody-based single-cell technologies, such as flow cytometry, mass cytometry and CITE-seq, have become widely used in clinical diagnostics and basic research; however, their analysis is complicated by technical noise, batch effects, platform differences and restricted antibody panels. Here we present CytoVI, a probabilistic generative model for statistically rigorous unified analysis of antibody-based single-cell data. CytoVI generates informative cell embeddings, imputes missing measurements, performs differential protein expression testing and automates annotation of cells in a single probabilistic model. We applied CytoVI to build an integrated B cell maturation atlas spanning 350 proteins and identified proteins associated with immunoglobulin class-switching. In a cohort of patients with B cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma profiled by flow cytometry and CITE-seq, CytoVI uncovered disease-associated T cell states. CytoVI is available as open-source software at scvi-tools.org .
papers.whyCare: A generative model for single-cell data may offer reusable computational ideas, though its antibody-based data focus is not an obvious fit.
papers.skepticism: Possible methods for modeling single-cell screening or perturbation datasets.

lensReasons.main: 항체 기반 단일세포 자료의 결측 측정값 보정, 세포 유형 주석, 차등 단백질 발현 분석을 통합하는 도구이며 B세포 성숙과 림프종 자료에 적용했다. 단일세포 분석 실무에는 유용하지만, 초록에서 제시한 응용은 면역 단백질 자료에 한정되어 연구실의 주요 생물학 방향과의 직접적 연관은 크지 않다.
lensReasons.computational: 확률적 생성 모델과 단일세포 자료 통합 분석이 논문의 주된 기여다. 생물학적 적용 사례는 포함하지만, 실험적 검증을 수반하는 편집·소기관·조직 생물학 연구라기보다 계산 도구 논문에 가깝다.

papers.title: Quantitative machine learning of protein interactions reveals the multiscale organization and molecular syntax of signaling networks
papers.abstract: Cells employ dense networks of transient protein-protein interactions mediated by modular peptide-binding domains and unstructured peptidic motifs for high-fidelity information processing. How these networks physically execute computations through protein interactions governed by complex intra- and intermolecular mechanisms remains indiscernible from current, sparse and non-quantitative, maps of the human interactome. Here, we introduce a quantitative statistical mechanical modeling (QSM) approach for machine learning domain-peptide affinities with experimental-level accuracy. Leveraging a new, principled algorithm for data harmonization and a biophysically informed neural network architecture, QSM learns to predict dissociation constants directly from amino acid sequences with calibrated confidence. We use QSM to construct the first quantitative drafts of human signaling networks and study these networks across three physical scales--recognition mechanisms of modular binding domains, combinatorial logic of multi-dentate proteins, and pathways inferred from de novo inference of protein interaction networks. We find that (i) modular domains, based on their binding preferences, selectivities, and strengths, fall into a limited number of biophysical equivalence groups, (ii) those domains, along with peptidic motifs, are "syntactically" combined within proteins to yield multivalent recognition mechanisms, and (iii) the organization of cellular function can be traced back to algorithmically detectable modules induced by domain-mediated interactions. In aggregate, these analyses instantiate a tractable roadmap towards a comprehensive, mechanistic, and simulatable articulation of the systems biology of signaling.
papers.shortSummary: QSM은 서열만으로 domain–peptide 해리상수와 신뢰도를 예측하고, 이를 이용해 신호전달 네트워크의 물리적·다중 스케일 조직을 정량적으로 분석할 수 있다는 주장이다.
papers.whyCare: 결합 여부 중심의 네트워크 지도 대신 서열로부터 친화도를 추정하면, 도메인–모티프 상호작용의 세기와 다가성 효과를 반영한 신호전달 모델링으로 이어질 수 있다. 다만 이는 초록에서 제시한 목표와 주장이지, 다른 단백질 설계·예측 과제의 성능 증거는 아니다.
papers.skepticism: 초록은 ‘실험 수준 정확도’와 보정된 신뢰도를 주장하지만 수치, 데이터 범위, 분할 방식, 외부 또는 전향적 검증을 제시하지 않는다. 유사 서열·도메인이 학습과 평가에 함께 들어갔다면 성능이 과대평가될 수 있다. 데이터 조화 알고리즘, 모델 공개 여부, 신규 상호작용의 습식실험 검증 여부도 초록만으로는 확인되지 않는다.

lensReasons.main: 정량 결합 예측으로 신호전달 네트워크의 다가 인식과 도메인 군집을 해석하지만, 생물학적 결론은 계산 추론에 기반한다.
lensReasons.computational: 주요 산출물은 결합 친화도 예측 모델과 그에 따른 네트워크 분석이며, 새로운 실험적 인과 검증은 보고되지 않았다.

papers.title: AtomWeaver: Multi-Component Flow Matching with a Structured Geometric Prior Facilitates Non-Canonical Peptide Design
papers.abstract: Fixed-backbone sequence discovery, or inverse folding, is a critical recurring task in the development of new polypeptide therapeutics. Once promising backbones are established for a target pocket, computational inverse folding methods greatly help accelerate generation of candidate sequences. Such methods are mature for the traditional case of limiting to the fixed twenty-letter canonical vocabulary; however, they cannot access the broader space of non-canonical amino acids (NCAAs). This design constraint is exacerbated for peptide binders, a fast-growing modality that readily incorporates NCAAs, though in practice non-canonical design frequently depends on laborious medicinal-chemistry campaigns. An extension of inverse folding to NCAAs is thus critical to accelerating design of novel therapeutic peptides. AtomWeaver uses a joint all-site, atom-level generative scheme that does not restrict side-chain categorical assignment by either predetermined or co-resolving residue identity. Conditioned only on a fixed peptide backbone and its target protein, its multi-component flow guides side-chain atoms as unlabeled points in R3 from a nested shell prior to a variable-count final atom cloud. Identity is then read by matching each predicted cloud against a reference library of canonical and non-canonical templates. Since identity is decided only at decode time, the addressable vocabulary is a property of the library rather than of the trained weights: a new NCAA costs one reference structure and no retraining, and the model can select residues it was never prompted for and never saw in training. On a deep mutational scan of two peptide-target systems, AtomWeaver's canonical readout shows high observed mean agreement with experimental values among the compared inverse-folding methods. In the mixed canonical-noncanonical setting that canonical-only baselines cannot support at all, it likewise retains ranking signal across both systems. AtomWeaver also displayed self-consistent designs on de novo binder backbones, with the highest interface confidence among compared methods. Notably, it reached these metrics while achieving broad empirical coverage of our 300-residue vocabulary, including four non-canonical types never visible in training. AtomWeaver thus serves canonical and non-canonical peptide design alike, while transforming residue vocabulary to an expandable inference-time choice.
papers.shortSummary: 백본과 표적만 조건으로 원자 위치를 생성한 뒤 잔기 정체성을 추론 시 템플릿 대조로 결정하면, 모델 재학습 없이 canonical 및 NCAA 펩타이드 서열을 설계할 수 있다는 주장이다.
papers.whyCare: 기존 역접힘 모델의 20종 아미노산 어휘 제약을 완화해, 펩타이드 설계에서 NCAA 후보 탐색을 계산 단계에 넣을 가능성을 제시한다. 특히 새 잔기마다 모델을 재학습하는 대신 템플릿을 추가하는 방식은 라이브러리 확장이 쉬운 운영상의 이점이다.
papers.skepticism: 증거는 두 펩타이드-표적 시스템에 한정되고, 비교 모델·평가지표·효과 크기는 초록에 구체적으로 제시되지 않는다. de novo binder 결과는 자기일관성과 인터페이스 confidence이지 실험 결합 검증이 아니다. 또한 미학습 NCAA도 추론 시 참조 구조가 필요하므로, 이는 템플릿 수준의 제로샷 확장이지 화학을 전혀 보지 않은 일반화는 아니다. 템플릿 라이브러리와 평가 세트 간 누출 가능성, 코드·가중치 공개 여부도 초록만으로 확인할 수 없다.

papers.title: Reproducibility in biomedical research
papers.abstract: Reproducibility has long been considered a foundation of trustworthy science, yet practices that enable reproducible research remain inconsistently implemented, despite widespread awareness and establishment of policies and guidelines. Biomedical research that cannot be reproduced can lead to resource waste and adversely impact patient safety, public health outcomes, scientific progress and public trust. Rapid advances in technology, scientific dissemination and clinical translation have prompted renewed emphasis on validating research methods and findings to ensure transparency, rigor and credibility. Here we provide an overview of the current landscape of reproducible research in the biomedical sciences, summarize current efforts to harmonize terminology and implementation, and highlight the persistent barriers to adoption of best practices. We outline a practical framework to promote more uniform implementation and explore future directions for advancing reproducibility across stakeholders in the research process, including researchers, institutions, journals and funders.
